Active_UVM_Notes: Wrote 0xDEADBEEF to 0x0001_4010 and read back. Golden returns 0xDEADBEEF. Mutant shifts decode resulting in unmapped access (returns 0x00000000).

Active_UVM_Notes: Reads to 0x0001_2800 and 0x0001_2FFC expect unmapped 0x00000000 (Golden). Mutant translates these to SENSOR 0x00 (Battery Pct) returning 0x00000050.

Active_UVM_Notes: Targeted read of 0x0001_100C strictly enforces Golden specification of RF_ID_VALUE (0x5246_5430). Mutant routed idle sensor rdata resulting in 0x00000000.

Notes: VDP writes stuck at 0. UNOBSERVABLE since neither FW accesses VDP.
Active_UVM_Notes: Proved structurally equivalent: vdp_native_slave.v ignores m_write entirely and relies purely on m_wstrb to infer writes. Forcing vdp_write = 1'b0 in interconnect has zero functional effect.

Notes: RAM strobe always 4'hF. Escaped both because the firmware likely only issues full 32-bit word writes (strobe=0xF natively).
Active_UVM_Notes: Wrote 0xAABBCCDD word, then byte 0xFF to offset 1 (strobe 0x2). Golden accurately applies byte strobe to yield 0xAABBFFDD. Mutant forces 0xF strobe, overwriting entire word with 0xFFFFFFFF.

Notes: RF slave never sees valid. UNOBSERVABLE since neither FW accesses RF.
Active_UVM_Notes: Tested using isolated RF ID read (0x0001_100C). Golden completes. Mutant forces rf_valid to 0, so RF slave never returns ready, causing 500-cycle UVM_FATAL timeout.

Notes: Sensor decode uses VDP base. Detected by both Directed (firmware failure marker 0xDEAD0001 emitted) and UVM.
Active_UVM_Notes: Reads SENSOR_STATUS (0x0001_2000). Golden routes correctly and returns initialized BATT_PCT (0x50). Mutant compares against VDP_BASE, so SENSOR decode fails and SoC returns unmapped 0x0.

Notes: RAM LSBs zeroed. Escaped both because the PicoRV32 bus is word-aligned; lower 2 bits are already always 00.
Active_UVM_Notes: Proved structurally equivalent: soc_ram.v explicitly drops addr[1:0] via word_addr = addr[17:2] since native bus defines byte addressing via strobes. Forcing interconnect m_addr[1:0]=0 has zero functional effect.

Notes: Unmapped accesses hang the bus. UNOBSERVABLE since neither FW accesses unmapped memory.
Active_UVM_Notes: Read 0x0001_F000 (unmapped). Golden completes immediately with 0x0. Mutant hangs, causing 500-cycle UVM_FATAL timeout.

Active_UVM_Notes: Active RAL writes CTRL=1 and polls STATUS bit1. Mutant forces START condition false so axis_start never pulses and DONE is never set — 500-poll timeout triggers UVM_ERROR.

Active_UVM_Notes: Active RAL writes 0xBEEFCAFE to WEIGHT4_L then reads back. Mutant maps 0x30 to WEIGHT3_L so write is lost — readback returns 0. Scoreboard also catches wrong NN result.

Active_UVM_Notes: Active RAL writes distinct values to INPUT0_L and INPUT1_L then reads INPUT0_L back. Mutant returns INPUT1_L data — mismatch caught. Firmware escapes because it never reads input registers back.

Active_UVM_Notes: Active RAL reads RESULT0_L after DONE. Mutant returns result1[31:0] instead — scoreboard catches mismatch against C DPI reference model.

Active_UVM_Notes: Active RAL polls STATUS bit1 for DONE. Mutant swaps bits so active BUSY appears as DONE — premature result read returns 0x00000000 instead of computed value. Scoreboard catches mismatch.
